props.name: children
props.description: The content to display in the button.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the button.

props.name: staticColor
props.description: The static color style to apply. Useful when the ToggleButton appears over a color background.

props.name: isQuiet
props.description: Whether the button should be displayed with a quiet style.

props.name: isEmphasized
props.description: Whether the selected ToggleButton should be emphasized.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: ref
props.type: ((el: HTMLButtonElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLButtonElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the underlying button element.

props.name: id
props.description: Preferred group key prop, parity with RAC item id usage.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the button's selection state changes.

props.name: aria-controls
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the button.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the button.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: The id of the element that provides detailed, extended description for the button.

props.name: aria-disabled
props.description: Indicates that the button is perceivable but disabled.

props.name: aria-expanded
props.description: Whether the popup is expanded.

props.name: aria-haspopup
props.description: Whether the button has a popup.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible label for the button.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that labels the button.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the button is disabled.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Handler called when the press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressStart
props.description: Handler called when a press interaction starts.

props.name: onPressEnd
props.description: Handler called when a press interaction ends.

props.name: onPressUp
props.description: Handler called when a press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressChange
props.description: Handler called when the press state changes.

props.name: preventFocusOnPress
props.description: Whether the button should not receive focus on press.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.

props.name: excludeFromTabOrder
props.description: Whether to exclude the button from the tab order.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Whether the button is selected (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The default selected state (uncontrolled).

props.name: toggleKey
props.description: Key used when inside ToggleButtonGroup selection state.
